en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad bend in a river with wooded banks and fields. A paddle steamer with passengers is seen in the foreground on the river. On the right bank there are rocky slopes and a few houses along the shoreline. The scene is rural and framed by low hills in the distance. Printed German text along the bottom reads the location and the feature of the river bend.
